mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness that triggers recessionary expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 3.5%), a declining unemployment rate signals strong consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signal monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), a declining manufacturing output signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
